subject: The Logical End Point of AI Job Interviews Is Two Bots Talking to Each Other
posts:
When job hunters and recruiters both deploy AI agents, the hiring process collapses into a meaningless bot-on-bot loop.
Evidence: ghosting, automated screeners, chatgpt voice
#AI #Tech

AI recruitment tools streamline corporate hiring and help overwhelmed companies connect efficiently with qualified candidates.
Stated Judgement: (1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Corporate screening bots trap applicants in ghost-interviews while applicants deploy synthetic agents, creating a useless data loop.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.75, -0.80) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Automated hiring pretexts collapse into hollow feedback loops that extract user data while offering zero actual jobs.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 28)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Corporate AI Screening: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Hides behind efficiency pretext to ghost applicants.
- Candidate AI Bots: COND (0.0, -0.2) — Defensive counter-measure against dead-end loops.
As job applications surge, companies deploy voice AI to screen candidates, leading desperate applicants to use AI interviewers in return.

The Poison:
The normalization of synthetic administrative loops that waste human time and generate useless data shadows.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (efficient filtering) with WHO (mutual human validation). The system optimizes for corporate metrics while severing human connection.

Social Physics Analysis:
Companies run a Smart Selfish Maneuver: hiding behind automated efficiency pretexts while offloading administrative labor onto applicants, sparking defensive bot mimicry.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. The automated screening pretext masks pure extraction.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI hiring tools reduce human potential to automated data points.

The Unavoidable Lie: Automated screeners save time for both candidates and employers.

Alethekanon:
When administrative tools decouple entirely from human accountability, they become closed loops of mutual irrelevance.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking to watch people pour their hopes into applications only to be greeted by an unfeeling machine talking to another machine.

Brothekanon:
Wild that people are literally sending ChatGPT to talk to recruiter bots while no actual human is even on the other end.

Spirithekanon:
"He who gathers by labor increases it" Proverbs 13:11 PASS
Automating the hollow pursuit of labor only multiplies vanity and empty toil.
